actions.name: Use
actions.effect: one creature afflicted with Burning status effect

description.summary: The target for this spell requires the Burning status effect to be in effect.
description.value: The target for this spell requires the Burning status effect to be in effect. Once you cast this spell, the Burning status effect is removed and a blast of flame erupts from the creature, hitting all creatures within a 5- ft.- radius. Creatures within the area of effect take fire damage equal to your caster level (maximum 5) plus your Intelligence modifier, a Reflex save for half damage.
